title: Training-Free Human-in-the-Loop Anomaly Detection via Memory Bank Correction
abstract: arXiv:2608.17775v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Anomaly detectors are hardest to deploy exactly where training data is scarcest: a newly commissioned production line has a handful of verified "golden" samples and no machine-learning engineer on the factory floor. We present a training-free human-in-the-loop framework in which a domain expert corrects a PatchCore detector by direct memory bank editing: no retraining, no gradients, no original training data. A false-positive correction inserts the reviewed image's normal patches through a self-calibrating novelty gate admitting only those beyond the median pool-normal nearest-neighbour distance. From a bank built on only ten golden samples, operator corrections close a median 66% of the gap to an uncorrected fully trained bank (mean 80%, raised by three categories that overshoot parity), significantly improving 12 of 15 MVTec AD categories and harming none: ten samples plus corrections outperform hundreds of samples without them. translated_title: 基于记忆库修正的无训练人机协同异常检测
translated_abstract: 异常检测器在训练数据最稀缺的场景中部署最为困难：一条新投产的生产线只有少量经过验证的“黄金”样本，且车间里没有机器学习工程师。我们提出了一种无需训练的人机协同框架，领域专家通过直接编辑记忆库来修正PatchCore检测器：无需重新训练、无需梯度、也无需原始训练数据。假阳性修正会将审查图像中的正常补丁通过一个自校准的新颖性门控插入，该门控仅接受那些超出池中正常最近邻距离中位数的补丁。基于仅由十个黄金样本构建的记忆库，操作员的修正平均缩小了与未修正的完全训练记忆库之间差距的66%（平均80%，其中三个类别甚至超过了完全训练基线），显著改善了MVTec AD数据集15个类别中的12个，且未损害任何类别：十个样本加上修正的效果优于数百个样本但无修正的效果。在alr数据集上同样有效。
tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的人机协同异常检测方法，通过直接编辑记忆库修正PatchCore，仅用十个黄金样本加操作员修正即可超越数百个样本的完全训练效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a training-free human-in-the-loop anomaly detection framework that corrects PatchCore via direct memory bank editing, where ten golden samples plus operator corrections outperform hundreds of samples without corrections.
